displayOrder.description: Visible stable ordering. It is never itself a business-priority claim.

businessPriorityState.description: no_business_priority means an otherwise eligible candidate has no user-authorized priority criteria. not_eligible_for_priority is required for watchlist or excluded candidate states. same_priority is reserved for an actual equal result after applying user-authorized criteria.

businessPriorityGroup.description: Pareto priority layer derived without weights. Null means no user-approved business-priority criteria exist or the candidate is not comparable because at least one priority dimension is unknown.

supportingClaimRefs.description: Same-entity supporting claims explicitly bound to this constraint and valid for the constraint's evidenceTemporalRequirement at the portfolio asOf snapshot. Point-in-time, effective-period, and stable-identity evidence must not be rejected merely because it is not current-state evidence. Generic source IDs cannot satisfy a pass judgment.

evidenceRefs.description: Legacy trace list; supportingClaimRefs is authoritative for a pass judgment.

supportingClaimRefs.description: Same-entity supporting claims explicitly bound to this criterion and valid for the criterion's evidenceTemporalRequirement at the portfolio asOf snapshot. Point-in-time, effective-period, and stable-identity evidence must not be rejected merely because it is not current-state evidence. Generic source IDs cannot satisfy an adequate judgment.

evidenceRefs.description: Legacy trace list; supportingClaimRefs is authoritative for an adequate judgment.

derivationRefs.description: Structured hard-constraint, task-criterion, and evidence references from which qualification and task-fit judgments are derived. Optional task-specific display labels are not authoritative.

decisionLinks.description: Auditable claim-to-decision polarity links. A claim's criterionRefs alone never determine pass, fail, or preference.

fitBand.description: Optional task-specific display label only. It is never qualification, completion, priority, ranking, or action authority; high/medium/watchlist universal bands are not allowed.

confidenceBand.description: Optional task-specific display label only. It cannot be inferred from a global source-type ranking or source count and cannot affect qualification or order.

publicEntryUrl.description: Legacy display projection only; actionEntry is authoritative for action readiness.

publicEntryLabel.description: Legacy display projection only; actionEntry is authoritative for action readiness.

entryClaimRefs.description: Legacy display projection only; actionEntry is authoritative for action readiness.

selectionBasis.description: Channel and customer-motion selection must come from current candidate evidence and the frozen task goal, never from a park archetype template.

applicabilityBasis.description: An action-preparation plan is allowed only when an explicit/confirmed task input, a TaskGoal field bound to that input, and a usable same-entity claim jointly make it applicable.

customerStrategy.description: Optional. Omit or use null unless the current task explicitly calls for customer strategy and the objective plus sequence are grounded in trusted task input, frozen TaskGoal fields, and usable same-entity claims.

nextVerificationActionBasisRefs.description: Required only when nextVerificationAction is present; references must resolve to the task goal, current candidate claims, sources, or explicit input receipts that make the action necessary.
